        t.join(5000);
        if (t.isAlive()) { t.interrupt(); throw new AssertionError("thread did not stop: " + t.getName()); }
    }
    public static void stop(ExecutorService executor) throws InterruptedException {
        for (Runnable queued : executor.shutdownNow())
            if (queued instanceof Future<?> f) f.cancel(false);
        if (!executor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            throw new AssertionError("executor did not terminate");
    }
    public static Thread thread(String name, AtomicReference<Throwable> failure, Runnable body) {
        return Thread.ofPlatform().daemon().name(name).unstarted(() -> {
            try { body.run(); }
            catch (Throwable error) { failure.compareAndSet(null, error); }
        });
    }
    public static void rethrow(AtomicReference<Throwable> failure) {
        if (failure.get() != null) throw new AssertionError("worker failed", failure.get());
    }
}

存取款模拟：队首不足不能越过，存款触发有序完成

题目约定

金额是long最小货币单位，初始余额非负、交易金额为正。明确采用严格FIFO：队首余额不足时，后面金额更小的请求也不能越过。withdraw返回这次新完成的请求列表，不能完成的留下；deposit也返回被存款解锁的新完成列表，调用者按列表输出。队列有容量，满则拒绝且不占用请求ID；重复取款ID显式拒绝，不冒充“返回原结果”的幂等重放。

我会这样保证正确性

一个monitor保护余额、FIFO队列和历史ID。drain只从队首检查与扣减，余额始终非负，每个已接收取款最多被移出并完成一次。deposit先Math.addExact再赋值，溢出不改余额或队列；不能把先检查余额和后扣款拆成两个独立线程安全操作。

复杂度

单次存取可能触发k个排队请求，O(k)，每个请求最多入出一次；队列O(capacity)，历史ID集合O(total requests)没有淘汰。不是因为有界队列就整个进程内存有界。

边界测试

先排20再排5，余额10时两个均等待；补10仅完成队首，补5完成第二个；满队列拒绝、重复ID拒绝、非正金额、Long.MAX_VALUE溢出不变；100存款与100取款并发检查唯一完成、总额与排队归零。

适用边界

这是内存输出模拟，不使用真实银行账户。没有持久化、请求重放结果查询、存款幂等、取消取款或账户间转账。如果面试要求评审一段指定代码，需要先拿到代码，再判断它是否满足这些条件。

面试官继续追问时

若要求取消排队请求，需要明确取消与完成竞争的原子结果；若要求跨进程/崩溃恢复，余额、请求状态、输出事件需事务化，并用稳定请求身份恢复，不能把输出丢失当成再次扣款理由。

FifoBank.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public final class FifoBank {
    public record Withdrawal(String id, long amount) {}
    private long balance;
    private final ArrayDeque<Withdrawal> waiting = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Set<String> usedIds = new HashSet<>();
    private final int capacity;
    public FifoBank(long balance, int capacity) {
      if (balance < 0 || capacity < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
      this.balance = balance; this.capacity = capacity;
    }
    // FIFO: a smaller later withdrawal never bypasses an unfunded head.
    public synchronized List<Withdrawal> withdraw(String id, long amount) {
      if (id == null || id.isBlank() || amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
      if (usedIds.contains(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate request id");
      if (waiting.size() >= capacity) throw new RejectedExecutionException("queue full");
      usedIds.add(id); waiting.addLast(new Withdrawal(id, amount));
      return drain();
    }
    public synchronized List<Withdrawal> deposit(long amount) {
      if (amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
      balance = Math.addExact(balance, amount); // no mutation if overflow
      return drain();
    }
    private List<Withdrawal> drain() {
      List<Withdrawal> done = new ArrayList<>();
      while (!waiting.isEmpty() && waiting.peekFirst().amount() <= balance) {
        Withdrawal w = waiting.removeFirst(); balance -= w.amount(); done.add(w);
      }
      return List.copyOf(done);
    }
    public synchronized long balance() { return balance; }
    public synchronized int pending() { return waiting.size(); }
  }

wait/notify 生产者消费者栈：LIFO、关闭和重新检查谓词

先说清题目约定

正容量、禁止null；满栈push等待、空栈pop等待。close拒绝之后的push，并允许pop按LIFO排空；空且关闭返回Optional.empty。close幂等，等待可中断。

为什么这样写是正确的

容量检查、push/pop、关闭标志均由同一个monitor保护，改变状态后notifyAll。wait释放monitor，醒来再用while检查；通知不等于可以操作。pop/push的容器修改是线性化点，关闭同样在锁内。没有把等待写成if，也没有把不同锁保护的size当真相。

时间和空间成本

正常push/pop摊还O(1)，存储O(capacity)；notifyAll可唤醒多个线程，争锁成本不计为常数保证。

怎样验证边界

验证LIFO、满栈生产者阻塞、无状态改变的notifyAll不会读空、关闭唤醒生产者、关闭后排空、空队列消费者取消。

哪些条件需要另行处理

评审指定代码时，需要拿到完整片段；下面给出满足当前约定的实现和测试。

MonitorStack.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** 单 JVM 有界 LIFO；close 后拒绝 push，允许 pop 排空，空且关闭返回 Optional.empty。 */
public final class MonitorStack<T> {
    private final ArrayDeque<T> values = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final int capacity; private boolean closed;
    private int waitingPushers, waitingPoppers; private long pushWaits, popWaits;
    public MonitorStack(int capacity) { if(capacity<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException(); this.capacity=capacity; }
    public synchronized void push(T value) throws InterruptedException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value);
        while(!closed && values.size()==capacity){waitingPushers++;pushWaits++;try{wait();}finally{waitingPushers--;}}
        if(closed)throw new IllegalStateException("closed");
        values.push(value); notifyAll();
    }
    public synchronized Optional<T> pop() throws InterruptedException {
        while(!closed && values.isEmpty()){waitingPoppers++;popWaits++;try{wait();}finally{waitingPoppers--;}}
        if(values.isEmpty())return Optional.empty();
        T value=values.pop();notifyAll();return Optional.of(value);
    }
    public synchronized void close(){closed=true;notifyAll();}
    /** Test-only: the synchronized observation can occur only after the worker released this monitor in wait. */
    long awaitWaitingForTest(boolean producer,long after) throws InterruptedException {
        long start=System.nanoTime();
        while(System.nanoTime()-start<TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5)) {
            synchronized(this){long generation=producer?pushWaits:popWaits;
                if((producer?waitingPushers:waitingPoppers)>0 && generation>after)return generation;}
            Thread.sleep(1); // Timing is not the blocking witness; the same-monitor state is.
        }
        throw new AssertionError("worker never reached wait");
    }
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        MonitorStack<Integer> s=new MonitorStack<>(2);s.push(1);s.push(2);
        if(s.pop().orElseThrow()!=2 || s.pop().orElseThrow()!=1)throw new AssertionError("LIFO");
        ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        try{
            Future<Optional<Integer>> wait=p.submit(s::pop);
            // 模拟无状态改变的通知；while 必须重新检查谓词。
            long firstWait=s.awaitWaitingForTest(false,0);
            synchronized(s){s.notifyAll();}
            s.awaitWaitingForTest(false,firstWait); // Witness a NEW wait after notification and predicate recheck.
            if(wait.isDone())throw new AssertionError("spurious empty read");
            s.push(7);if(wait.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS).orElseThrow()!=7)throw new AssertionError();
            s.push(8);s.push(9);Future<?> blocked=p.submit(()->{s.push(10);return null;});
            s.awaitWaitingForTest(true,0);if(blocked.isDone())throw new AssertionError("capacity");
            s.close();
            try{blocked.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS);throw new AssertionError();}catch(ExecutionException e){if(!(e.getCause() instanceof IllegalStateException))throw e;}
            if(s.pop().orElseThrow()!=9 || s.pop().orElseThrow()!=8 || s.pop().isPresent())throw new AssertionError("drain");
            MonitorStack<Integer> empty=new MonitorStack<>(1);CountDownLatch stopped=new CountDownLatch(1);
            AtomicReference<Throwable> interruption=new AtomicReference<>();
            Future<?> cancelled=p.submit(()->{try{empty.pop();}catch(Throwable outcome){interruption.set(outcome);}finally{stopped.countDown();}});
            long prior=empty.awaitWaitingForTest(false,0);cancelled.cancel(true);
            if(!stopped.await(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("interrupted worker still active");
            // Check the separate worker result on main: a cancelled Future cannot report its failure.
            if(!(interruption.get() instanceof InterruptedException))throw new AssertionError("pop must throw InterruptedException",interruption.get());
            Future<Optional<Integer>> closed=p.submit(empty::pop);empty.awaitWaitingForTest(false,prior);empty.close();
            if(closed.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS).isPresent() || empty.pop().isPresent())throw new AssertionError("closed empty");
            try{empty.push(1);throw new AssertionError("first push after close");}catch(IllegalStateException expected){}
        }finally{p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("MonitorStack PASS: LIFO, capacity, unrelated notification, close/drain, interruption");
    }
}

并发延时队列 Java 对照：小根堆、提前插入唤醒与取消

先说清题目约定

put非null值、delay非负且不超过100年；内部用System.nanoTime相对创建原点，队列寿命也限制100年，避免绝对排序溢出。get可中断，空时等待，到期才取；同deadline按单调序号稳定排序，序号溢出拒绝。close立即丢弃尚未执行任务、拒绝put并唤醒get返回empty，不采用等待未来deadline排空的另一种合同。

为什么这样写是正确的

堆、关闭标志、序号都在同一ReentrantLock下；每次醒来重新取堆顶和剩余时间。新元素插入后signalAll，原来等较晚任务的线程会重新计算，从而处理更早任务插队。awaitNanos释放锁，不能持锁sleep。

时间和空间成本

put/取堆顶O(log n)，peek O(1)，空间O(n)，无容量上限；关闭clear为O(n)。signalAll有惊群成本，工程版可再设计leader/follower优化。

怎样验证边界

空堆阻塞、先放1秒任务再放即时任务能提前返回、白盒精确同deadline的稳定次序、阻塞中断、关闭丢弃与拒写。

哪些条件需要另行处理

不会承诺精确实时调度；OS/JVM暂停可延后执行。没有Go工具链验证；Java锁/Condition并不等于Go timer/channel API。

DelayHeap.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.*;

/** Java 对照实现，不是 Go timer/channel/race 验证。关闭立即丢弃待执行任务并唤醒 Get。 */
public final class DelayHeap<T> {
    private record Item<T>(T value,long deadline,long sequence){}
    private final PriorityQueue<Item<T>> heap=new PriorityQueue<>((a,b)->{
        int c=Long.compare(a.deadline(),b.deadline());return c!=0?c:Long.compare(a.sequence(),b.sequence());});
    private final ReentrantLock lock=new ReentrantLock();private final Condition changed=lock.newCondition();
    private final long origin=System.nanoTime();private long sequence;private boolean closed;
    // 相对单调原点，队列生命周期与最大 delay 各小于 100 年，避免排序/加法溢出。
    private static final long LIMIT=TimeUnit.DAYS.toNanos(36500);
    private long now(){long n=System.nanoTime()-origin;if(n<0 || n>LIMIT)throw new IllegalStateException("clock/lifetime bound");return n;}
    public void put(T value,long delay,TimeUnit unit){
        Objects.requireNonNull(value);Objects.requireNonNull(unit);long nanos=unit.toNanos(delay);
        if(delay<0 || nanos>LIMIT)throw new IllegalArgumentException("delay 0..100 years");
        lock.lock();try{if(closed)throw new IllegalStateException("closed");long next=Math.incrementExact(sequence);
            heap.add(new Item<>(value,Math.addExact(now(),nanos),sequence));sequence=next;changed.signalAll();
        }finally{lock.unlock();}
    }
    public Optional<T> get()throws InterruptedException{
        lock.lockInterruptibly();try{for(;;){if(closed)return Optional.empty();Item<T> first=heap.peek();
            if(first==null){changed.await();continue;}long wait=first.deadline()-now();
            if(wait<=0)return Optional.of(heap.remove().value());changed.awaitNanos(wait);
        }}finally{lock.unlock();}
    }
    public void close(){lock.lock();try{closed=true;heap.clear();changed.signalAll();}finally{lock.unlock();}}
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        DelayHeap<Integer> q=new DelayHeap<>();ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        try{
            Future<Optional<Integer>> f=p.submit(q::get);
            try{f.get(20,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);throw new AssertionError("empty not blocking");}catch(TimeoutException expected){}
            q.put(2,1,TimeUnit.SECONDS);q.put(1,0,TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
            if(f.get(500,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS).orElseThrow()!=1)throw new AssertionError("earlier item did not reset wait");
            q.close();if(q.get().isPresent())throw new AssertionError("close discards");
            try{q.put(3,0,TimeUnit.SECONDS);throw new AssertionError();}catch(IllegalStateException expected){}
            DelayHeap<Integer> tie=new DelayHeap<>();tie.lock.lock();try{
                // 精确同一 deadline 的白盒测试；公共 Put 的采样时间通常不同。
                long deadline=tie.now();tie.heap.add(new Item<>(1,deadline,0));tie.heap.add(new Item<>(2,deadline,1));
            }finally{tie.lock.unlock();}
            if(tie.get().orElseThrow()!=1 || tie.get().orElseThrow()!=2)throw new AssertionError("stable tie");
            CountDownLatch entered=new CountDownLatch(1),interrupted=new CountDownLatch(1);
            Thread t=new Thread(()->{entered.countDown();try{tie.get();}catch(InterruptedException e){interrupted.countDown();}});t.setDaemon(true);t.start();
            entered.await();t.interrupt();t.join(1000);if(t.isAlive() || interrupted.getCount()!=0)throw new AssertionError("interrupt");
            Future<Optional<Integer>> closed=p.submit(tie::get);tie.close();if(closed.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS).isPresent())throw new AssertionError();
        }finally{q.close();p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("DelayHeap PASS: empty blocking, earlier insertion, stable equal deadlines, interrupt, close/discard");
    }
}

CAS 链式无锁队列：无界 MPMC 与线性化点

先说清题目约定

每节点仅创建一次、不复用，Java GC回收不可达节点；head/tail/next均为AtomicReference，dummy不表示有效队首元素。没有容量、阻塞等待、超时或close，调用者用业务停止标志结束轮询。

为什么这样写是正确的

offer成功把旧tail.next从null CAS到新节点是入队线性化点；tail推进只是帮助优化。poll成功把head CAS到next是出队线性化点；next为空的稳定快照可线性化为空返回。遇到tail落后就帮助前进，不等某个指定线程。旧引用不会指向被手工释放并复用的新对象，所以不用原生语言式hazard pointer；仍需避免以后引入对象池破坏此前提。

时间和空间成本

无竞争时每次常数步，竞争重试不保证单操作有界；算法是lock-free而非wait-free，单个线程可能饥饿。空间O(n)，最后一次出队值可能由当前dummy保留到下一次出队；分配和GC本身不提供实时无阻塞保证。

怎样验证边界

顺序FIFO/空/null测试，以及4生产者+4消费者共40000唯一值并发无丢重；线程检查中断，测试有时间上限。

哪些条件需要另行处理

压力测试不是形式化线性化证明；正确性依据另述的线性化点与Java原子发布语义。禁止把它写成有界CAS环或C++内存回收实现。

CasLinkedQueue.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

/** Michael–Scott 风格无界 MPMC；非空元素，poll 空返回 null；Java GC，无节点复用。 */
public final class CasLinkedQueue<T> {
    private static final class Node<T>{final T value;final AtomicReference<Node<T>> next=new AtomicReference<>();Node(T value){this.value=value;}}
    private final AtomicReference<Node<T>> head,tail;
    public CasLinkedQueue(){Node<T> dummy=new Node<>(null);head=new AtomicReference<>(dummy);tail=new AtomicReference<>(dummy);}
    public void offer(T value){Node<T> node=new Node<>(Objects.requireNonNull(value));for(;;){Node<T> t=tail.get(),next=t.next.get();if(t!=tail.get())continue;
        if(next==null){if(t.next.compareAndSet(null,node)){tail.compareAndSet(t,node);return;}}
        else tail.compareAndSet(t,next);
    }}
    public T poll(){for(;;){Node<T> h=head.get(),t=tail.get(),next=h.next.get();if(h!=head.get())continue;
        if(next==null)return null;
        if(h==t){tail.compareAndSet(t,next);continue;}
        T value=next.value;if(head.compareAndSet(h,next))return value;
    }}
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        CasLinkedQueue<Integer> q=new CasLinkedQueue<>();if(q.poll()!=null)throw new AssertionError();
        for(int i=0;i<100;i++)q.offer(i);for(int i=0;i<100;i++)if(q.poll()!=i)throw new AssertionError("FIFO");
        try{q.offer(null);throw new AssertionError();}catch(NullPointerException expected){}
        int n=10000;AtomicInteger producers=new AtomicInteger(4);Set<Integer>seen=ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);CountDownLatch start=new CountDownLatch(1);
        try{List<Future<?>>fs=new ArrayList<>();for(int k=0;k<4;k++){final int base=k*n;fs.add(p.submit(()->{start.await();try{for(int i=0;i<n;i++)q.offer(base+i);}finally{producers.decrementAndGet();}return null;}));}
            for(int k=0;k<4;k++)fs.add(p.submit(()->{start.await();for(;;){Integer v=q.poll();if(v!=null){if(!seen.add(v))throw new AssertionError("duplicate");}
                else if(producers.get()==0){v=q.poll();if(v==null)break;if(!seen.add(v))throw new AssertionError("duplicate");}
                else {if(Thread.interrupted())throw new InterruptedException();Thread.onSpinWait();}}
                return null;}));
            start.countDown();for(Future<?>f:fs)f.get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if(seen.size()!=4*n || q.poll()!=null)throw new AssertionError("lost");
        }finally{p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("CasLinkedQueue PASS: FIFO/null/empty, MPMC 4+4 40000 unique values; stress is not linearizability proof");
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/** Java SynchronousQueue/ArrayBlockingQueue 对照；不声称实现或验证 Go channel 的 close/select。 */
public final class ChannelAnalogue {
    public static List<Integer> produce100(int capacity)throws Exception{
        if(capacity<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();BlockingQueue<Integer> q=capacity==0?new SynchronousQueue<>():new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(capacity);
        ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);List<Future<?>>fs=new ArrayList<>();
        try{
            fs.add(p.submit(()->{for(int i=1;i<=100;i++)q.put(i);q.put(-1);return null;}));
            Future<List<Integer>> received=p.submit(()->{List<Integer>x=new ArrayList<>();for(;;){int v=q.take();if(v==-1)return x;x.add(v);}});fs.add(received);
            long start=System.nanoTime(),budget=TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(2);for(Future<?>f:fs){long left=budget-(System.nanoTime()-start);if(left<=0)throw new TimeoutException();f.get(left,TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);}return received.get();
        }finally{for(Future<?>f:fs)f.cancel(true);p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        for(int capacity:new int[]{0,1,8}){List<Integer>x=produce100(capacity);if(x.size()!=100)throw new AssertionError();for(int i=0;i<100;i++)if(x.get(i)!=i+1)throw new AssertionError();}
        // 中断阻塞 put/take；保证退出而不是依赖 sentinel 能成功入队。
        for(boolean producer:new boolean[]{false,true}){CountDownLatch done=new CountDownLatch(1);BlockingQueue<Integer>q=new SynchronousQueue<>();Thread t=new Thread(()->{try{if(producer)q.put(1);else q.take();}catch(InterruptedException expected){done.countDown();}});t.setDaemon(true);t.start();t.interrupt();t.join(1000);if(t.isAlive()||done.getCount()!=0)throw new AssertionError();}
        System.out.println("ChannelAnalogue PASS: capacities0/1/8 exact1..100, blocked put/take interruption; Java only");
    }
}

消息队列手册：机制、具体条件与可靠性边界

Q56 固定容量并发队列怎样写

使用 head、tail、size 区分满空，所有共享状态在同一把锁内修改，close 后拒绝新 push 并允许存量排空。

先把接口状态说清：Push 返回 ACCEPTED、FULL 或 CLOSED；Pop 也用状态表示空队列，不能拿元素值 0/false 代替。null 不属于合法元素。

再看环形数组怎样移动：插入推进 tail，弹出推进 head；只有 head，没有尾部、计数或其他状态，无法区分满与空，也可以由 head+size 推导 tail。有效 push 的成功/失败计数在锁内一致更新，非法 null 参数不计入。

单次数组操作 O(1)，空间 O(capacity)，等待锁和 take 的阻塞时间另计。take 用 while 重查条件处理虚假唤醒；close 唤醒所有等待者。生产者遇到 FULL 应由上层背压/延期处理，不应在业务中无限忙等。这是内存队列，进程崩溃无法恢复。

不能仅凭示例中的测试数量、性能数字、PASS 文本与预期输出，认定已在当前环境复验或取得个人项目业绩。运行练习前须核对版本、依赖、输入条件与代码完整性；算法和手写实现如有节选，以注明的范围为准。

有界阻塞队列怎样写才正确

一把锁保护完整队列不变量，两个条件队列分别等非空与非满；所有等待用 while 重查，关闭唤醒所有等待者。

题意与契约

实现多生产者、多消费者共用的有界 FIFO。满时 put 阻塞，空时 take 阻塞；获取锁和条件等待均可被中断。容量须为正，禁止 null。close 后拒绝新的写入，但读者可排空已有元素，之后 take 返回 null。增加带总超时的 offer，超时返回 false；关闭时抛出 IllegalStateException，不把关闭混成“暂时满了”。

例子：容量 2，put A、put B 后 put C 等待；消费者 take A 后 C 才能入队。关闭且尚有 B、C 时仍依次返回 B、C，最后返回 null。

状态、不变量与条件队列

用固定 Object[] 环形数组，head 是下一次取的位置，tail 是下一次放的位置，count 区分 head==tail 时究竟空还是满。不变量为 0≤count≤capacity，数组中从 head 起的 count 个位置按 FIFO 保存有效元素。

所有下标、计数和关闭标记由同一把 ReentrantLock 保护。生产者等 notFull，消费者等 notEmpty：一次入队只增加一个可消费元素，signal 一个消费者即可；一次出队只增加一个空位，signal 一个生产者即可。

close 改变了所有等待者的终止条件，因此两组都要 signalAll。练习时让生产者等满队列、消费者等空队列，再分别发生出队、入队和关闭，说明谁应该醒来。醒来后仍须用 while 重查条件，因为 Condition 没有消除虚假唤醒。

完整实现

backend-scenarios 原语言代码 L2567–2639（完整围栏，未执行）
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;

public final class CloseableBoundedQueue<E> {
    private final Object[] elements;
    private int head, tail, count;
    private boolean closed;
    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final Condition notEmpty = lock.newCondition();
    private final Condition notFull = lock.newCondition();
    public CloseableBoundedQueue(int capacity) {
        if (capacity <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity > 0 required");
        elements = new Object[capacity];
    }
    public void put(E value) throws InterruptedException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, "null is the end-of-stream marker");
        lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (!closed && count == elements.length) notFull.await();
            checkOpen(); enqueue(value);
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public E take() throws InterruptedException {
        lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (!closed && count == 0) notEmpty.await();
            return count == 0 ? null : dequeue();
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    /** Timeout includes acquiring the lock; false means capacity was unavailable. */
    public boolean offer(E value, long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value); Objects.requireNonNull(unit);
        if (timeout < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative timeout");
        long budget = unit.toNanos(timeout), start = System.nanoTime();
        if (!lock.tryLock(budget, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)) return false;
        try {
            long left = budget - (System.nanoTime() - start);
            while (!closed && count == elements.length) {
                if (left <= 0) return false;
                notFull.awaitNanos(left);
                left = budget - (System.nanoTime() - start);
            }
            checkOpen(); enqueue(value); return true;
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public void close() {
        lock.lock();
        try { closed = true; notEmpty.signalAll(); notFull.signalAll(); }
        finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public int size() {
        lock.lock();
        try { return count; } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    private void checkOpen() {
        if (closed) throw new IllegalStateException("queue closed");
    }
    private void enqueue(E value) {
        elements[tail] = value;
        tail = (tail + 1) % elements.length; count++;
        notEmpty.signal();
    }
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private E dequeue() {
        E value = (E) elements[head];
        elements[head] = null;            // Do not retain removed objects.
        head = (head + 1) % elements.length; count--;
        notFull.signal();
        return value;
    }
}

环形数组演算

容量 3，初始 head=tail=count=0。放 A、B 后 tail=2、count=2；取 A 后 head=1、count=1，并把原数组位置清成 null；再放 C、D 后 tail 回绕到 1，count=3。此时 head==tail 但队列满，内容依次是 B、C、D，因此不能只凭两个下标判断空满。

超时 offer 用 System.nanoTime 测经过时间，整个锁获取加条件等待共享一个预算。每次被唤醒后重新计算剩余值，不能每次重新给完整 timeout，否则反复唤醒可以把总等待无限拉长。

成本与边界测试

入/出队的状态操作最坏 O(1)，数组存储 O(C)，等待时间不包含在算法计算复杂度里。close 和 size 也需要获取锁，不是无等待操作。普通操作使用非公平锁，不保证每个等待者严格 FIFO 获得机会。

测试容量 1、非法容量、环绕、满队列 offer 超时、获取锁时中断、await 中断、关闭时同时存在生产者/消费者、排空后返回 null、关闭后写入失败、移除后引用清理。业务回调不能在队列锁里运行；消费者先 take，再在锁外调用慢服务，避免一次慢请求阻塞所有人。

多个生产者结束时不能由第一个结束者直接 close。应由拥有整个流水线的协调者等待所有生产者结束再关闭，或维护生产者剩余计数，最后一个结束者关闭；若任何生产者失败，还要决定整体取消还是允许消费已有数据。这是任务生命周期问题，队列本身无法推测业务含义。

多线程 FIFO 如何说明线性化

先约定不等数据的无界 FIFO 契约，再用一把锁保护哑元头、尾和计数，解释每次操作的线性化点。

FIFO 的契约

只说“线程安全队列”不足以决定实现。这里先做无界 FIFO：offer 放入非 null 元素，poll 在当前为空时返回 null，不因“没有元素”而等待；size 返回持锁时的精确瞬时长度。多个生产者、消费者并发安全。此队列内部用了互斥锁，获取锁仍可能阻塞，所以“poll 不等数据”不能误叫作 lock-free 或 wait-free。

如果要求容量、背压、超时、关闭，直接采用本章的阻塞队列的有界环形队列；如果是常见无界并发队列需求，优先评估 JDK ConcurrentLinkedQueue。不要没有需求就强行手写复杂 CAS 队列。

从单线程链表到并发不变量

使用一个哑元节点 head，真实首元素是 head.next，tail 指向末节点。空队列时 head==tail 且 head.next==null。入队必须把旧 tail.next 与 tail 的修改放在同一个锁保护范围；出队把首节点提升为新哑元，并清空其 item，避免长期保留已经消费的对象。

同一锁保护 head、tail、count，所有消费者一次只能删除一个真实首节点，所以不会重复消费；所有生产者原子地接到当前尾部，不会覆盖另一生产者的 next。offer 的线性化点可选锁内接链完成时；poll 的线性化点是 head 向前推进时。非重叠操作满足真实先后，重叠操作则由锁内生效顺序决定。

完整实现

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;

/** Non-waiting-for-data FIFO. Lock acquisition can still block. */
public final class LockedFifo<E> {
    private static final class Node<E> {
        E item; Node<E> next;
        Node(E item) { this.item = item; }
    }
    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
    private Node<E> head = new Node<>(null); // Dummy node, never returned as an element.
    private Node<E> tail = head;
    private long count;
    public void offer(E value) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value);
        Node<E> node = new Node<>(value);
        lock.lock();
        try {
            tail.next = node; tail = node; count++;
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public E poll() {
        lock.lock();
        try {
            Node<E> first = head.next;
            if (first == null) return null;
            E value = first.item;
            head = first;              // New dummy; when empty head and tail are identical.
            first.item = null; count--;
            return value;
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public long size() {
        lock.lock();
        try { return count; } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
}

哑元节点演算

开始 H 为哑元，head=tail=H。offer A 后 H→A 且 tail=A；offer B 后 H→A→B。poll 返回 A，把 head 移到 A 并清空 A.item；下一次 poll 返回 B，head=tail=B，重新为空。再 offer C 连接在 B 后面，所以排空后仍可复用，不需要特殊重置旧哑元。

成本与语义陷阱

不计锁等待，offer/poll/size 都是 O(1)，N 个待消费元素占 O(N) 节点空间。无界只是没有人为容量上限，内存仍然有限；生产速度长期高于消费速度会持续增长并可能 OOM。

即使刚刚看到 size()>0，poll 仍可能返回 null：两次调用之间，另一个消费者可能已经取走元素。因此 if(size()>0) poll() 不能作为一个原子判断，调用者必须处理 null。

本手写版本的 O(1) size 来自锁内计数；ConcurrentLinkedQueue 的 size 则不能被当作廉价、强一致的实时计数器。比较实现时要核对各自合同，不能把这个锁实现的性质推广到所有并发队列。

无锁追问需要真正解释 CAS 修改 head/tail、尾指针落后时的帮助推进、线性化点和内存回收。普通 AtomicReference 包装 head、tail 再做多步修改不自动得到正确队列；“用了 CAS”也不自动证明没有丢元素或满足 lock-free 进度保证。面试允许使用标准库时，说明采用成熟实现通常比现场写一个未经验证的 Michael–Scott 变体更可靠。

测试与完整验证记录

针对队列，测试空 poll、拒绝 null、顺序入队顺序出队、排空再入队、多个生产者唯一 ID 不丢不重、多消费者竞争、size 只作为快照使用。验证 FIFO 应按每个生产者内部已经发生的先后关系或记录线性化顺序，不能武断要求不同线程的数字 ID 全局升序。

void check(bool value, const char* message) { if (!value) throw std::runtime_error(message); }

template<class T> class BlockingQueue {
    static_assert(std::is_nothrow_move_constructible_v<T> && std::is_nothrow_destructible_v<T>,
                  "queue elements must have nonthrowing move construction and destruction");
    std::mutex mutex_;
    std::condition_variable not_empty_, not_full_;
    std::queue<T> data_;
    const std::size_t capacity_;
    bool closed_ = false;
public:
    explicit BlockingQueue(std::size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {
        if (!capacity) throw std::invalid_argument("positive capacity required");
    }
    bool push(T item) {
        std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
        not_full_.wait(lock, [&] { return closed_ || data_.size() < capacity_; });
        if (closed_) return false;
        try { data_.push(std::move(item)); }
        catch (...) {
            // A failed allocation did not consume the slot; let another producer try.
            lock.unlock(); not_full_.notify_one(); throw;
        }
        lock.unlock(); not_empty_.notify_one(); return true;
    }
    std::optional<T> pop() {
        std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
        not_empty_.wait(lock, [&] { return closed_ || !data_.empty(); });
        if (data_.empty()) return std::nullopt;
        T value = std::move(data_.front()); data_.pop();
        lock.unlock(); not_full_.notify_one(); return value;
    }
    void close() {
        { std::lock_guard lock(mutex_); closed_ = true; }
        not_empty_.notify_all(); not_full_.notify_all();
    }
};

/** Every shard owns an independent unordered_map, so each rehash stays under its shard lock. */
template<class K, class V, std::size_t N = 8> class ShardedMap {
    static_assert(N > 0);
    struct Shard { mutable std::shared_mutex mutex; std::unordered_map<K, V> data; };
    std::array<Shard, N> shards_;
    std::size_t index(const K& key) const { return std::hash<K>{}(key) % N; }
public:
    void put(const K& key, const V& value) {
        auto& shard = shards_[index(key)]; std::unique_lock lock(shard.mutex);
        shard.data.insert_or_assign(key, value);
    }
    std::optional<V> get(const K& key) const {
        const auto& shard = shards_[index(key)]; std::shared_lock lock(shard.mutex);
        auto it = shard.data.find(key);
        if (it == shard.data.end()) return std::nullopt;
        return it->second; // A copy, not an iterator/reference whose lifetime escapes the lock.
    }
    bool erase(const K& key) {
        auto& shard = shards_[index(key)]; std::unique_lock lock(shard.mutex);
        return shard.data.erase(key) != 0;
    }
    std::unordered_map<K, V> snapshot() const {
        std::vector<std::shared_lock<std::shared_mutex>> locks;
        locks.reserve(N);
        for (const auto& shard : shards_) locks.emplace_back(shard.mutex); // One global lock order.
        std::unordered_map<K, V> copy;
        for (const auto& shard : shards_) copy.insert(shard.data.begin(), shard.data.end());
        return copy;
    }
};

/** Only ordinary lock/unlock protect metadata. Busy waiting is for the constrained exercise. */
class MutexOnlyRwLock {
    std::mutex state_;
    unsigned readers_ = 0, waiting_writers_ = 0;
    bool writer_ = false;
public:
    void lock_shared() {
        for (;;) {
            state_.lock();
            if (!writer_ && waiting_writers_ == 0) { ++readers_; state_.unlock(); return; }
            state_.unlock(); std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    }
    void unlock_shared() { state_.lock(); --readers_; state_.unlock(); }
    void lock() {
        state_.lock(); ++waiting_writers_; state_.unlock();
        for (;;) {
            state_.lock();
            if (!writer_ && readers_ == 0) {
                --waiting_writers_; writer_ = true; state_.unlock(); return;
            }
            state_.unlock(); std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    }
    void unlock() { state_.lock(); writer_ = false; state_.unlock(); }
};

public:

    Singleton& operator=(const Singleton&) = delete;

    BlockingQueue<int> queue(8);
    std::mutex seen_mutex, error_mutex;
    std::vector<bool> seen(4000);
    std::exception_ptr error;
    auto protect = [&](auto body) {
        try { body(); }
        catch (...) {
            { std::lock_guard lock(error_mutex); if (!error) error = std::current_exception(); }
            queue.close();
        }
    };
    std::vector<std::thread> producers, consumers;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) consumers.emplace_back([&] { protect([&] {
        while (auto item = queue.pop()) {
            std::lock_guard lock(seen_mutex);
            check(*item >= 0 && *item < 4000 && !seen[*item], "duplicate/range"); seen[*item] = true;
        }
    }); });
    for (int p = 0; p < 4; ++p) producers.emplace_back([&, p] { protect([&] {
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) check(queue.push(p * 1000 + i), "unexpected close");
    }); });
    for (auto& producer : producers) producer.join();
    queue.close();
    for (auto& consumer : consumers) consumer.join();
    if (error) std::rethrow_exception(error);
    for (bool value : seen) check(value, "lost item");
    check(!queue.push(0) && !queue.pop().has_value(), "closed behavior");
    BlockingQueue<int> full(1); check(full.push(0), "zero accepted");
    std::atomic<bool> rejected{false};
    std::thread blocked([&] { rejected = !full.push(1); }); full.close(); blocked.join();
    check(rejected && full.pop() == 0 && !full.pop(), "close releases producer and drains");
    ShardedMap<int, int> map;
    std::vector<std::thread> writers;
    for (int t = 0; t < 4; ++t) writers.emplace_back([&, t] {
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) map.put(t * 1000 + i, i);
    });
    for (auto& writer : writers) writer.join();
    check(map.snapshot().size() == 4000 && map.get(3999) == 999, "sharded map rehash/copy");
    check(map.erase(3999) && !map.get(3999), "erase");
    MutexOnlyRwLock rw; int counter = 0;
    writers.clear();
    for (int t = 0; t < 4; ++t) writers.emplace_back([&] {
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) { std::lock_guard lock(rw); ++counter; }
    });
    for (auto& writer : writers) writer.join();
    { std::shared_lock lock(rw); check(counter == 4000, "mutex-only RW protocol"); }
    check(&Singleton::instance() == &Singleton::instance(), "C++11 local-static singleton");
    // std::thread::join waits for the child to finish using the captured resource.
    int resource = 0; std::mutex resource_mutex;
    std::thread child([&] { std::lock_guard lock(resource_mutex); resource = 7; }); child.join();
    check(resource == 7, "child resource use completed");
    std::atomic<int> inventory{1}; int expected = 1;
    check(inventory.compare_exchange_strong(expected, 0), "atomic CAS");
    std::cout << "native_cpp OK\n";

package main

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "sync"
    "sync/atomic"
    "time"
)

var ErrClosed = errors.New("queue closed")

// CondQueue implements its own ring and conditions, not a channel wrapper.
type CondQueue[T any] struct {
    mu sync.Mutex
    notEmpty, notFull *sync.Cond
    data []T
    head, tail, count int
    closed bool
}
func NewCondQueue[T any](capacity int) *CondQueue[T] {
    if capacity <= 0 { panic("capacity must be positive") }
    q := &CondQueue[T]{data: make([]T, capacity)}
    q.notEmpty, q.notFull = sync.NewCond(&q.mu), sync.NewCond(&q.mu)
    return q
}
func (q *CondQueue[T]) Push(ctx context.Context, value T) error {
    q.mu.Lock()
    stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() {
        q.mu.Lock(); q.notFull.Broadcast(); q.mu.Unlock()
    })
    defer func() { q.mu.Unlock(); stop() }()
    for q.count == len(q.data) && !q.closed && ctx.Err() == nil { q.notFull.Wait() }
    if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return err }
    if q.closed { return ErrClosed }
    q.data[q.tail] = value; q.tail = (q.tail + 1) % len(q.data); q.count++
    q.notEmpty.Signal()
    return nil
}
// Pop returns (zero, ErrClosed) only after closed inventory has drained.
func (q *CondQueue[T]) Pop(ctx context.Context) (T, error) {
    q.mu.Lock()
    stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() {
        q.mu.Lock(); q.notEmpty.Broadcast(); q.mu.Unlock()
    })
    defer func() { q.mu.Unlock(); stop() }()
    var zero T
    for q.count == 0 && !q.closed && ctx.Err() == nil { q.notEmpty.Wait() }
    if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return zero, err }
    if q.count == 0 { return zero, ErrClosed }
    value := q.data[q.head]; q.data[q.head] = zero
    q.head = (q.head + 1) % len(q.data); q.count--
    q.notFull.Signal()
    return value, nil
}
func (q *CondQueue[T]) Close() {
    q.mu.Lock(); q.closed = true
    q.notEmpty.Broadcast(); q.notFull.Broadcast(); q.mu.Unlock()
}

type Result struct { ID, Value int; Err error }
func safeCall(ctx context.Context, id int, fn func(context.Context, int) (int, error)) (r Result) {
    r.ID = id
    defer func() { if p := recover(); p != nil { r.Err = fmt.Errorf("task panic: %v", p) } }()
    r.Value, r.Err = fn(ctx, id)
    return
}
// Separate exercise: channels coordinate bounded workers. Functions must cooperate with ctx.
func RunChannelPool(ctx context.Context, workers, count int, fn func(context.Context, int) (int, error)) ([]Result, error) {
    if workers <= 0 || count < 0 { return nil, errors.New("invalid size") }
    jobs := make(chan int, workers)
    results := make(chan Result, workers)
    var wg sync.WaitGroup
    for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
        wg.Add(1)
        go func() {
            defer wg.Done()
            for {
                if ctx.Err() != nil { return }
                select {
                case <-ctx.Done(): return
                case id, ok := <-jobs:
                    if !ok || ctx.Err() != nil { return }
                    result := safeCall(ctx, id, fn)
                    select { case results <- result: case <-ctx.Done(): return }
                }
            }
        }()
    }
    producerDone := make(chan struct{})
    go func() {
        defer close(producerDone); defer close(jobs)
        for id := 0; id < count; id++ {
            select { case jobs <- id: case <-ctx.Done(): return }
        }
    }()
    go func() { wg.Wait(); close(results) }()
    collected := make([]Result, 0, count)
    for result := range results { collected = append(collected, result) }
    <-producerDone
    return collected, ctx.Err()
}

type Snapshot struct { Version int; Limit int }
func require(ok bool, message string) { if !ok { panic(message) } }
func runChecks() {
    ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
    defer cancel()
    q := NewCondQueue[int](8)
    var producers, consumers sync.WaitGroup
    seen := make(map[int]bool); var seenMu sync.Mutex
    failures := make(chan error, 8)
    for c := 0; c < 4; c++ {
        consumers.Add(1)
        go func() {
            defer consumers.Done()
            for {
                value, err := q.Pop(ctx)
                if errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) { return }
                if err != nil { failures <- err; return }
                seenMu.Lock()
                if seen[value] { failures <- errors.New("duplicate"); seenMu.Unlock(); return }
                seen[value] = true; seenMu.Unlock()
            }
        }()
    }
    for p := 0; p < 4; p++ {
        base := p*1000; producers.Add(1)
        go func() {
            defer producers.Done()
            for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ { if err := q.Push(ctx, base+i); err != nil { failures <- err; return } }
        }()
    }
    producers.Wait(); q.Close(); consumers.Wait(); close(failures)
    for err := range failures { panic(err) }
    require(len(seen) == 4000, "MPMC loss")
    require(errors.Is(q.Push(ctx, 0), ErrClosed), "close rejects push")
    small := NewCondQueue[int](1)
    require(small.Push(ctx, 0) == nil, "zero is valid")
    cancelled, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx); stop()
    require(errors.Is(small.Push(cancelled, 1), context.Canceled), "cancel full push")
    small.Close(); value, err := small.Pop(ctx)
    require(err == nil && value == 0, "drain zero")
    _, err = small.Pop(ctx); require(errors.Is(err, ErrClosed), "closed end")
    empty := NewCondQueue[int](1)
    waiting, release := context.WithCancel(ctx)
    done := make(chan error, 1)
    go func() { _, err := empty.Pop(waiting); done <- err }()
    release()
    select { case err := <-done: require(errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), "cancel wait")
    case <-ctx.Done(): panic("cancel did not wake condition") }
    results, err := RunChannelPool(ctx, 5, 100, func(ctx context.Context, id int) (int, error) {
        if id == 7 { panic("controlled") }; return id*id, nil
    })
    require(err == nil && len(results) == 100, "worker count/results")
    panicCount := 0
    for _, r := range results { if r.Err != nil { panicCount++ } }
    require(panicCount == 1, "panic isolated inside worker goroutine")
    var stock atomic.Int64; stock.Store(1)
    require(stock.CompareAndSwap(1, 0) && !stock.CompareAndSwap(1, 0), "Go atomic CAS")
    var root atomic.Pointer[Snapshot]
    root.Store(&Snapshot{Version: 1, Limit: 10})
    old := root.Load(); root.Store(&Snapshot{Version: 2, Limit: 20})
    require(old.Version == 1 && root.Load().Version == 2, "immutable snapshot publication")
    fmt.Println("native_go OK")
}
func main() { runChecks(); cacheAndTenantChecks() }

package main

import (
    "container/list"
    "context"
    "errors"
    "sync"
    "time"
)

type ttlEntry[K comparable, V any] struct { key K; value V; expires time.Time }
type TTLLru[K comparable, V any] struct {
    mu sync.Mutex
    capacity int
    ttl time.Duration
    clock func() time.Time
    entries map[K]*list.Element
    recency *list.List
}
func NewTTLLru[K comparable, V any](capacity int, ttl time.Duration, clock func() time.Time) *TTLLru[K, V] {
    if capacity < 0 || ttl <= 0 || clock == nil { panic("invalid TTL LRU configuration") }
    return &TTLLru[K,V]{capacity: capacity, ttl: ttl, clock: clock, entries: make(map[K]*list.Element), recency: list.New()}
}
func (c *TTLLru[K,V]) remove(element *list.Element) {
    delete(c.entries, element.Value.(*ttlEntry[K,V]).key); c.recency.Remove(element)
}
func (c *TTLLru[K,V]) Get(key K) (V, bool) {
    c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock()
    var zero V
    element := c.entries[key]
    if element == nil { return zero, false }
    item := element.Value.(*ttlEntry[K,V])
    if !c.clock().Before(item.expires) { c.remove(element); return zero, false }
    c.recency.MoveToFront(element); return item.value, true
}
func (c *TTLLru[K,V]) Put(key K, value V) {
    c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock()
    now := c.clock()
    // This simple native version explicitly pays O(n) for expiry-first cleanup.
    for element := c.recency.Back(); element != nil; {
        previous := element.Prev()
        if !now.Before(element.Value.(*ttlEntry[K,V]).expires) { c.remove(element) }
        element = previous
    }
    if element := c.entries[key]; element != nil {
        item := element.Value.(*ttlEntry[K,V]); item.value = value; item.expires = now.Add(c.ttl)
        c.recency.MoveToFront(element); return
    }
    if c.capacity == 0 { return }
    if len(c.entries) == c.capacity { c.remove(c.recency.Back()) }
    c.entries[key] = c.recency.PushFront(&ttlEntry[K,V]{key, value, now.Add(c.ttl)})
}

type tenantKey struct{}
func WithTenant(ctx context.Context, verifiedTenant string) context.Context {
    return context.WithValue(ctx, tenantKey{}, verifiedTenant)
}
type TenantLimiter struct {
    mu sync.Mutex
    users map[string][]time.Time
    limit, maxTenants int
    window time.Duration
    clock func() time.Time
}
func NewTenantLimiter(limit, maxTenants int, window time.Duration, clock func() time.Time) *TenantLimiter {
    if limit <= 0 || maxTenants <= 0 || window <= 0 || clock == nil { panic("invalid limiter configuration") }
    return &TenantLimiter{users: make(map[string][]time.Time), limit: limit, maxTenants: maxTenants, window: window, clock: clock}
}
func (l *TenantLimiter) Allow(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
    if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return false, err }
    tenant, ok := ctx.Value(tenantKey{}).(string)
    if !ok || tenant == "" { return false, errors.New("verified tenant missing") }
    l.mu.Lock(); defer l.mu.Unlock()
    if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return false, err }
    now := l.clock()
    for key, times := range l.users {
        first := 0
        for first < len(times) && !times[first].Add(l.window).After(now) { first++ }
        if first == len(times) { delete(l.users, key) } else if first > 0 {
            copy(times, times[first:]); l.users[key] = times[:len(times)-first]
        }
    }
    times, exists := l.users[tenant]
    if !exists && len(l.users) >= l.maxTenants { return false, nil }
    if len(times) >= l.limit { return false, nil }
    l.users[tenant] = append(times, now); return true, nil
}
func cacheAndTenantChecks() {
    now := time.Unix(0, 0)
    cache := NewTTLLru[string,int](2, 10*time.Second, func() time.Time { return now })
    cache.Put("a", 1); now = now.Add(5*time.Second); cache.Put("b", 2)
    now = now.Add(4*time.Second); _, hit := cache.Get("a"); require(hit, "touch a")
    now = now.Add(time.Second); cache.Put("c", 3)
    _, a := cache.Get("a"); _, b := cache.Get("b"); require(!a && b, "expiry independent of recency")
    limiter := NewTenantLimiter(2, 2, time.Minute, func() time.Time { return now })
    ctx := WithTenant(context.Background(), "authenticated-tenant")
    first, err := limiter.Allow(ctx); require(first && err == nil, "tenant admission")
    second, _ := limiter.Allow(ctx); third, _ := limiter.Allow(ctx); require(second && !third, "tenant limit")
    cancelled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx); cancel()
    _, err = limiter.Allow(cancelled); require(errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), "tenant cancellation")
}

多窗口售票与停车场容量：两个独立小型 Java 合同

先说清题目约定

票号1..N，N=0立即售罄；多窗口共享同一Tickets，sell无票/取消返回空，cancel停止后续售票而不撤销已售票。停车tryEnter满位拒绝，enter提供可中断的容量限时等待（预算从取得monitor后开始）；同一活动车牌重复进入视为幂等成功，重复exit不再增加空位。close拒绝新准入，已有车辆仍能离开。车牌要求非null；实际识别可信性由调用方负责。

为什么这样写是正确的

票号检查与递增在一个monitor内；停车集合检查、添加、删除也在一个monitor内。占位量直接来自集合size，避免集合与额外Semaphore计数失配。exit只有实际删除成功才唤醒，等待者循环检查满位条件并扣减单个总预算。

时间和空间成本

售票O(1)、O(1)状态；停车HashSet期望O(1)查询/修改、O(capacity)状态，哈希冲突有最坏退化。

怎样验证边界

8窗口同起跑售出1000个唯一票号，验证零库存和取消；100辆竞争3位不超限，重复进/出、满位超时、离开唤醒等待及关闭排空。

哪些条件需要另行处理

不是铁路区间票务系统，也不是原停车场数据库/设备流程实现。取消只影响未来sell；synchronized的争锁本身不可中断，也不在enter的timeout预算内；整个调用没有端到端限时保证。临界区刻意有限且不做I/O。CloseableRing的tryLock与Condition则共用获取锁加条件等待的总预算，两者合同不同。

TicketParking.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

/** 两个独立建模：票号不可回收；停车用活动车辆集合，防止重复出场多还许可。 */
public final class TicketParking {
    public static final class Tickets {
        private final int total;private int next=1;private boolean closed;
        public Tickets(int total){if(total<0 || total==Integer.MAX_VALUE)throw new IllegalArgumentException();this.total=total;}
        public synchronized OptionalInt sell(){if(closed || next>total)return OptionalInt.empty();return OptionalInt.of(next++);}
        public synchronized void cancel(){closed=true;}
    }
    public static final class Parking {
        private final int capacity;private final Set<String> parked=new HashSet<>();private boolean closed;
        private int waiting;private long waitStarts;
        public Parking(int capacity){if(capacity<=0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();this.capacity=capacity;}
        /** 原题未指定满位行为：提供即时拒绝及可中断限时等待两个明确 API。 */
        public synchronized boolean tryEnter(String plate){Objects.requireNonNull(plate);if(closed)throw new IllegalStateException("closed");if(parked.contains(plate))return true;if(parked.size()==capacity)return false;parked.add(plate);return true;}
        /** timeout covers capacity waiting after acquiring this monitor, not monitor acquisition; monitor acquisition is not interruptible. */
        public synchronized boolean enter(String plate,long timeout,TimeUnit unit)throws InterruptedException{
            Objects.requireNonNull(plate);if(timeout<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException();long budget=unit.toNanos(timeout),start=System.nanoTime();
            while(!closed && !parked.contains(plate) && parked.size()==capacity){long left=budget-(System.nanoTime()-start);if(left<=0)return false;waiting++;waitStarts++;try{TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.timedWait(this,left);}finally{waiting--;}}
            return tryEnter(plate);
        }
        /** Test-only: same-monitor observation proves enter already released this monitor in timedWait. */
        long awaitWaitingForTest(long after)throws InterruptedException{
            long start=System.nanoTime();
            while(System.nanoTime()-start<TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5)){
                synchronized(this){if(waiting>0 && waitStarts>after)return waitStarts;}
                Thread.sleep(1); // Poll spacing only; never use a sleep as the blocking assertion.
            }
            throw new AssertionError("enter never reached timedWait");
        }
        public synchronized boolean exit(String plate){Objects.requireNonNull(plate);boolean removed=parked.remove(plate);if(removed)notifyAll();return removed;}
        public synchronized int occupancy(){return parked.size();}
        public synchronized void close(){closed=true;notifyAll();}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
        Tickets tickets=new Tickets(1000);Set<Integer> sold=ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
        ExecutorService p=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);CountDownLatch go=new CountDownLatch(1);
        try{
            List<Future<?>>fs=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<8;i++)fs.add(p.submit(()->{go.await();for(;;){OptionalInt n=tickets.sell();if(n.isEmpty())break;if(!sold.add(n.getAsInt()))throw new AssertionError("duplicate");}return null;}));go.countDown();for(Future<?>f:fs)f.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if(sold.size()!=1000 || !sold.contains(1) || !sold.contains(1000))throw new AssertionError("oversell");
            if(new Tickets(0).sell().isPresent())throw new AssertionError();Tickets cancelled=new Tickets(2);cancelled.cancel();if(cancelled.sell().isPresent())throw new AssertionError();
            Parking park=new Parking(3);fs.clear();AtomicInteger admitted=new AtomicInteger();
            for(int i=0;i<100;i++){String plate="p"+i;fs.add(p.submit(()->{if(park.tryEnter(plate))admitted.incrementAndGet();}));}for(Future<?>f:fs)f.get(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if(admitted.get()!=3 || park.occupancy()!=3)throw new AssertionError("capacity");
            Parking one=new Parking(1);if(!one.tryEnter("a") || !one.tryEnter("a") || one.tryEnter("b"))throw new AssertionError();
            if(!one.exit("a") || one.exit("a") || one.occupancy()!=0)throw new AssertionError("duplicate exit");
            one.tryEnter("b");if(one.enter("c",10,TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))throw new AssertionError("timeout");
            Future<Boolean> waiter=p.submit(()->one.enter("c",1,TimeUnit.DAYS));
            one.awaitWaitingForTest(0);one.exit("b");if(!waiter.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("producer consumer wake");
            one.close();if(!one.exit("c"))throw new AssertionError("drain exit");
            try{one.enter("late",0,TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);throw new AssertionError("first entry after close");}catch(IllegalStateException expected){}
            Parking closing=new Parking(1);closing.tryEnter("held");
            Future<Boolean> rejected=p.submit(()->closing.enter("blocked",1,TimeUnit.DAYS));
            closing.awaitWaitingForTest(0);closing.close();
            try{rejected.get(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS);throw new AssertionError("close must reject waiting entry");}catch(ExecutionException e){if(!(e.getCause() instanceof IllegalStateException))throw e;}
            if(!closing.exit("held"))throw new AssertionError("closed vehicles may leave");
            Parking interrupted=new Parking(1);interrupted.tryEnter("held");CountDownLatch stopped=new CountDownLatch(1);
            Future<?> cancelledEntry=p.submit(()->{try{interrupted.enter("waiting",1,TimeUnit.DAYS);throw new AssertionError("interrupt");}catch(InterruptedException expected){}finally{stopped.countDown();}});
            interrupted.awaitWaitingForTest(0);cancelledEntry.cancel(true);
            if(!stopped.await(1,TimeUnit.SECONDS) || interrupted.occupancy()!=1)throw new AssertionError("interrupted admission");
        }finally{p.shutdownNow();if(!p.awaitTermination(2,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new AssertionError("leak");}
        System.out.println("TicketParking PASS: 1000 unique sales, zero/cancel, capacity3, duplicate enter/exit, timed wait, close");
    }
}

唤醒自测先在同一monitor内观察waiting与waitStarts；主线程能取得monitor说明worker已在timedWait中释放锁，然后才exit或close。长等待预算与较短Future.get界限区分通知唤醒和自然超时；另保留已关闭后首次进入与阻塞中断退出的独立用例。轮询sleep只降低测试忙等，不是进入等待的证明。

handwrite-56.category: 第三章：Java 并发与任务调度
handwrite-56.title: 手写阻塞队列/生产者消费者
handwrite-56.questionHtml: 实现一个固定容量的阻塞队列，支持多个生产者调用 put，多个消费者调用 take。队列满时生产者阻塞，队列空时消费者阻塞。
handwrite-56.analysisHtml:
只把元素放进 List 还不够：多个线程会同时改队列，满队列和空队列又需要等待不同条件。因此要把互斥修改与等待协作分开解释。

互斥：队列内部状态同一时刻只能被一个线程修改。

协作：队列满时生产者等待，队列空时消费者等待；状态变化后要精准唤醒对方。

if 只检查一次，而 while 会在唤醒后重新检查条件；signal 通知一个等待者，signalAll 通知全部等待者，关闭等影响所有人的状态变化需要后者。finally 释放锁，多生产者多消费者共享同一套不变量。
knowledge: ReentrantLock：显式锁，必须在 finally 中释放。
Condition：一个锁可以创建多个等待队列，如 notFull 和 notEmpty。
虚假唤醒：等待条件必须用 while 反复检查，不能用 if。
通知粒度：生产后通知消费者，消费后通知生产者。
工程替代：生产中优先使用 JDK 的 ArrayBlockingQueue、LinkedBlockingQueue。
handwrite-56.answerHtml:
我会用同一把锁保护队列状态，生产者在满时等 notFull，消费者在空时等 notEmpty。await 会释放锁，让另一方有机会改变状态；醒来重新拿锁后还要循环检查。放入一个元素通知消费者，取出一个元素通知生产者，这样等待不会阻止对方推进。

MyBlockingQueue.java
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.Condition;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;

public class MyBlockingQueue<T> {
    private final Queue<T> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final Condition notFull = lock.newCondition();
    private final Condition notEmpty = lock.newCondition();

    public MyBlockingQueue(int capacity) {
        if (capacity <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity must be positive");
        }
        this.capacity = capacity;
    }

    public void put(T value) throws InterruptedException {
        java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(value, "null elements unsupported");
        lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (queue.size() == capacity) {
                notFull.await();
            }
            queue.offer(value);
            notEmpty.signal();
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }

    public T take() throws InterruptedException {
        lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (queue.isEmpty()) {
                notEmpty.await();
            }
            T value = queue.poll();
            notFull.signal();
            return value;
        } finally {
            lock.unlock();
        }
    }
}

如果面试官要求支持超时，可以使用 awaitNanos 实现 offer(value, timeout) 和 poll(timeout)。固定数组环形队列可减少链节点分配，但吞吐和尾延迟仍取决于锁竞争、容量及工作负载，须测量，不能保证必然比链表更快。
handwrite-56.relatedHtml:
变体 1：为什么必须用 while？

分析：线程被唤醒不代表条件一定满足，可能是虚假唤醒，也可能被其他线程先抢到锁并消费了条件。答案：await 返回后必须重新检查队列状态。

变体 2：signal 和 signalAll 怎么选？

分析：有两个独立条件队列时，生产只唤醒消费者，消费只唤醒生产者，signal 通常足够。如果条件复杂或一个状态变化可能满足多类等待者，用 signalAll 更稳但会带来惊群。

变体 3：手写一个无锁队列可以吗？

分析：可以用 CAS + 链表实现 Michael-Scott Queue，但要处理 ABA、内存可见性和空队列竞争。Java 工程中通常使用 ConcurrentLinkedQueue，阻塞语义则用 BlockingQueue。

算法练习补充：基础数据结构追加并发约束后，怎样守住同一个不变量？

基础数据结构追加并发约束后，怎样守住同一个不变量？

把一次逻辑操作涉及的所有索引、链接和计数放进同一个原子边界，再定义等待、关闭和异常；分别让几个容器线程安全，并不能自动保证它们之间一致。

线程安全集合与同步原语可结合Java 集合与并发手册 (https://my.feishu.cn/wiki/LfZnwIeVXiamrIkAE2scnhqZnlb)继续复习。下面集中给出队列与缓存所需的完整类型、同步操作和调用入口。

两个栈实现线程安全队列

入栈接收新元素，仅当出栈为空时整体搬运，出栈顶始终是最老元素；检查、搬运、取值由同一个监视器保护。

每个元素至多从入栈搬到出栈一次，单次操作可能 O(n)，总成本摊还 O(1)，状态 O(n)。空队列 poll、peek 返回 null，所以禁止存 null。这不是阻塞队列；需要等待或关闭时应选择下面的条件变量模型。删除中间元素仍见 TwoStacks 的独立 O(n) 分支，不能把并发包装当作中间删除的复杂度优化。

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
public final class TwoStackQueue<E> {
    private final Deque<E> in = new ArrayDeque<>(), out = new ArrayDeque<>();
    public synchronized void offer(E value) { in.push(Objects.requireNonNull(value)); }
    private void transfer() { if(out.isEmpty()) while(!in.isEmpty()) out.push(in.pop()); }
    public synchronized E poll() { transfer(); return out.poll(); }
    public synchronized E peek() { transfer(); return out.peek(); }
    public synchronized int size() { return Math.addExact(in.size(),out.size()); }
    private static void check(boolean v) { if(!v) throw new AssertionError(); }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        TwoStackQueue<Integer> q=new TwoStackQueue<>(); check(q.poll()==null);
        try { q.offer(null); throw new AssertionError(); } catch(NullPointerException expected) { }
        q.offer(1);q.offer(2);check(q.peek()==1);check(q.poll()==1);q.offer(3);
        check(q.poll()==2 && q.poll()==3 && q.size()==0);

                    Thread.yield();continue;
                }

            }

            for(int i=0;i<20000;i++)q.offer(i);

            for(int i=0;i<4;i++)consumers.add(pool.submit(()->{Integer v;while((v=q.poll())!=null)check(seen.add(v));}));
            for(Future<?> f:consumers)f.get(10,TimeUnit.SECONDS);check(seen.size()==20000&&q.size()==0);

固定数组、O(1)、关闭、超时与成功失败计数

固定数组保存元素，head、tail、count 定位下一次出入位置；锁内的队列状态修改 O(1)，等待时间与获取锁时间不属于这个 CPU 成本。

CloseableRing 的接口先区分“没放进去”和“没取到”的原因。push 遇到满或关闭返回 false，并增加失败计数；null 属于非法参数，不算合法 push 请求。成功插入前先检查计数溢出，再更新数组，long 计数到上限就明确失败，不静默回绕。

pop 返回 ITEM、TIMEOUT 或 CLOSED，所以 0、false 仍能是普通数据。它的超时预算同时包含获取锁和条件等待，中断交给调用方处理。close 幂等并唤醒等待者：从这一刻起不再接收新元素，但已接收的元素仍可取走，只有排空后才返回 CLOSED。

空间 O(C)，C 为构造容量。它使用互斥锁，所以“满时不等待容量”不等于 lock-free；线程仍可能等待短锁。测试中的有限 yield 重试只是驱动例子，业务应选择背压、拒绝或有期限的重试策略。

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.*;

/** Fixed storage, O(1) queue mutation. Null is invalid; zero/false are ordinary values. */
public final class CloseableRing<E> {
    public enum Status { ITEM, TIMEOUT, CLOSED }
    public record Pop<E>(Status status, E value) {}
    public record Stats(int size, long successfulPushes, long failedPushes, boolean closed) {}
    private final Object[] data;
    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final Condition notEmpty = lock.newCondition();
    private int head, tail, count;
    private long successes, failures;
    private boolean closed;
    public CloseableRing(int capacity) {
        if (capacity <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity > 0");
        data = new Object[capacity];
    }
    /** Nonblocking with respect to capacity. Acquiring the short mutex can still wait. */
    public boolean push(E value) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value);
        lock.lock();
        try {
            if (closed || count == data.length) { failures = Math.incrementExact(failures); return false; }
            long next = Math.incrementExact(successes); // Validate before changing the queue.
            data[tail] = value; tail = (tail + 1) % data.length; count++; successes = next;
            notEmpty.signal(); return true;
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    /** Timeout covers lock acquisition plus condition waiting, measured with nanoTime. */
    public Pop<E> pop(long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws InterruptedException {
        if (timeout < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeout >= 0");
        long budget = unit.toNanos(timeout), start = System.nanoTime();
        if (!lock.tryLock(budget, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)) return new Pop<>(Status.TIMEOUT, null);
        try {
            long remaining = budget - (System.nanoTime() - start);
            while (count == 0 && !closed) {
                if (remaining <= 0) return new Pop<>(Status.TIMEOUT, null);
                notEmpty.awaitNanos(remaining);
                remaining = budget - (System.nanoTime() - start);
            }
            if (count == 0) return new Pop<>(Status.CLOSED, null);
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") E value = (E) data[head];
            data[head] = null; head = (head + 1) % data.length; count--;
            return new Pop<>(Status.ITEM, value);
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    /** Reject future pushes, wake consumers, and allow already accepted items to drain. */
    public void close() {
        lock.lock();
        try { closed = true; notEmpty.signalAll(); }
        finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public Stats stats() {
        lock.lock();
        try { return new Stats(count, successes, failures, closed); }
        finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    /** Test-only observation: acquire the same lock after await released it, then inspect its condition queue. */
    void awaitWaiterForTest(Condition condition) throws InterruptedException {
        long start=System.nanoTime(), budget=TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5);
        for (;;) {
            long left=budget-(System.nanoTime()-start);
            if(left<=0 || !lock.tryLock(left,TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS))throw new AssertionError("waiter never reached await");
            try { if(lock.hasWaiters(condition))return; } finally {lock.unlock();}
            Thread.sleep(1); // Poll spacing only; elapsed time is not proof of blocking.
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        CloseableRing<Integer> small = new CloseableRing<>(1);
        Checks.that(small.push(0) && !small.push(1), "zero accepted, full rejected");
        small.close(); small.close();
        Checks.that(!small.push(2), "closed rejects push");
        Checks.that(small.pop(0, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS).value() == 0, "drain after close");
        Checks.that(small.pop(0, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS).status() == Status.CLOSED, "closed distinct from value");
        Checks.that(small.stats().successfulPushes() == 1 && small.stats().failedPushes() == 2, "atomic counters");
        try { small.push(null); throw new AssertionError("null accepted"); } catch (NullPointerException expected) { }
        CloseableRing<Integer> queue = new CloseableRing<>(8);
        Set<Integer> seen = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet(); ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);
        try {
            List<Future<?>> consumers = new ArrayList<>(), producers = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) consumers.add(pool.submit(() -> {
                try {
                    for (;;) {
                        Pop<Integer> item = queue.pop(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                        if (item.status() == Status.CLOSED) return;
                        Checks.that(item.status() == Status.ITEM && seen.add(item.value()), "no loss/duplicate");
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); throw new AssertionError(e); }
            }));
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int base = i * 1000;
                producers.add(pool.submit(() -> {
                    long start = System.nanoTime();
                    for (int n = base; n < base + 1000; n++) while (!queue.push(n)) {
                        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() || System.nanoTime() - start > TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5))
                            throw new AssertionError("producer deadline");
                        Thread.yield(); // Only this finite test retries push; production should choose backpressure.
                    }
                }));
            }
            for (Future<?> producer : producers) Checks.get(producer);
            queue.close(); for (Future<?> consumer : consumers) Checks.get(consumer);
            Checks.that(seen.size() == 4000 && queue.stats().successfulPushes() == 4000 && queue.stats().size() == 0, "MPMC drain");
            CloseableRing<Integer> empty = new CloseableRing<>(1);
            Checks.that(empty.pop(0, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS).status() == Status.TIMEOUT, "zero-time poll");
            CountDownLatch stopped = new CountDownLatch(1);
            Future<?> waiting = pool.submit(() -> {
                try { empty.pop(1, TimeUnit.DAYS); throw new AssertionError("expected interrupt"); }
                catch (InterruptedException expected) { }
                finally { stopped.countDown(); }
            });
            empty.awaitWaiterForTest(empty.notEmpty); waiting.cancel(true); Checks.await(stopped);
            Future<Pop<Integer>> closing = pool.submit(() -> empty.pop(1, TimeUnit.DAYS));
            empty.awaitWaiterForTest(empty.notEmpty); // Same-lock observation proves the worker released the lock in await.
            empty.close(); Checks.that(Checks.get(closing).status() == Status.CLOSED, "close wakes waiting consumers");
            Checks.that(empty.pop(0, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS).status() == Status.CLOSED, "first call after close");
            CloseableRing<Integer> pushed = new CloseableRing<>(1);
            Future<Pop<Integer>> receiving = pool.submit(() -> pushed.pop(1, TimeUnit.DAYS));
            pushed.awaitWaiterForTest(pushed.notEmpty); pushed.push(7);
            Checks.that(Checks.get(receiving).value() == 7, "push wakes an already waiting consumer");
        } finally { queue.close(); Checks.stop(pool); }
        System.out.println("CloseableRing OK");
    }
}

如果生产者也必须阻塞等待空位，就增加 notFull；等待条件一定放在 while 里，唤醒后重新检查关闭和容量。ConditionQueue 的 take 用 null 表示关闭且排空，所以同样禁止存 null；put 在关闭后抛异常，阻塞线程可以中断。

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.*;

/** Bounded MPMC ring; close rejects puts and drains already accepted values. */
public final class ConditionQueue<E> {
    private final Object[] items;
    private int head, tail, size;
    private boolean closed;
    private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
    private final Condition notEmpty = lock.newCondition(), notFull = lock.newCondition();
    public ConditionQueue(int capacity) {
        if (capacity <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); items = new Object[capacity];
    }
    public void put(E value) throws InterruptedException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value); lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (!closed && size == items.length) notFull.await();
            if (closed) throw new IllegalStateException("closed");
            items[tail] = value; tail = (tail + 1) % items.length; size++; notEmpty.signal();
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public E take() throws InterruptedException {
        lock.lockInterruptibly();
        try {
            while (!closed && size == 0) notEmpty.await();
            if (size == 0) return null;
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") E value = (E) items[head];
            items[head] = null; head = (head + 1) % items.length; size--; notFull.signal(); return value;
        } finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    public void close() {
        lock.lock();
        try { closed = true; notEmpty.signalAll(); notFull.signalAll(); }
        finally { lock.unlock(); }
    }
    /** Test-only observation: acquire the same lock after await released it, then inspect its condition queue. */
    void awaitWaiterForTest(Condition condition) throws InterruptedException {
        long start=System.nanoTime(), budget=TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(5);
        for (;;) {
            long left=budget-(System.nanoTime()-start);
            if(left<=0 || !lock.tryLock(left,TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS))throw new AssertionError("waiter never reached await");
            try { if(lock.hasWaiters(condition))return; } finally {lock.unlock();}
            Thread.sleep(1); // Poll spacing only; elapsed time is not proof of blocking.
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        ConditionQueue<Integer> queue = new ConditionQueue<>(1); ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        try {
            queue.put(0);
            Future<?> full = pool.submit(() -> {
                try { queue.put(1); throw new AssertionError("closed put succeeded"); }
                catch (IllegalStateException expected) { }
                return null;
            });
            queue.awaitWaiterForTest(queue.notFull); queue.close(); Checks.get(full);
            Checks.that(queue.take() == 0 && queue.take() == null, "drain closed ring");
            ConditionQueue<Integer> interruptedQueue = new ConditionQueue<>(1);
            CountDownLatch done = new CountDownLatch(1);
            Future<?> wait = pool.submit(() -> {
                try { interruptedQueue.take(); throw new AssertionError("expected interrupt"); }
                catch (InterruptedException expected) { }
                finally { done.countDown(); }
            });
            interruptedQueue.awaitWaiterForTest(interruptedQueue.notEmpty); wait.cancel(true); Checks.await(done);
            ConditionQueue<Integer> wake = new ConditionQueue<>(1);
            Future<Integer> waiting = pool.submit(wake::take); wake.awaitWaiterForTest(wake.notEmpty); wake.close();
            Checks.that(Checks.get(waiting) == null, "close wakes empty side");
            Checks.that(wake.take() == null, "first take after close");
            try { wake.put(1); throw new AssertionError("first put after close"); } catch (IllegalStateException expected) { }
            ConditionQueue<Integer> transfer = new ConditionQueue<>(1); transfer.put(1);
            Future<?> put = pool.submit(() -> {transfer.put(2); return null;});
            transfer.awaitWaiterForTest(transfer.notFull); Checks.that(transfer.take() == 1, "FIFO first");
            Checks.get(put); Checks.that(transfer.take() == 2, "take wakes already waiting producer");
            Future<Integer> take = pool.submit(transfer::take); transfer.awaitWaiterForTest(transfer.notEmpty);
            transfer.put(3); Checks.that(Checks.get(take) == 3, "put wakes already waiting consumer");
        } finally { queue.close(); Checks.stop(pool); }
        System.out.println("ConditionQueue OK");
    }
}

原生 C++：有界生产者消费者与分片 Map

C++ 队列用 mutex 和两个 condition_variable，等待谓词同时检查关闭及容量，关闭后排空已有元素；线程生命周期由调用方 join 完成。

下面 BlockingQueue 允许多个生产者和消费者，单生产者多消费者是其特例。元素要求移动构造和析构不抛异常；分配失败时空位没有被占用，需要通知另一个生产者继续尝试。析构队列前必须保证没有线程仍访问它，close 本身不会替代 join。

ShardedMap 让每个分片各自拥有 unordered_map 与锁，使 rehash 也受同一分片锁保护；按固定分片顺序锁住全部分片才能形成一致快照。get 返回值副本，不把锁外可失效的迭代器泄露出去。同文件的仅 mutex 读写锁用于受限练习，会忙等且没有有界公平保证；实际应用通常优先使用标准共享互斥量。

import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** Small bounded test utilities; no assertion depends on -ea. */
public final class Checks {
    private Checks() {}
    public static void that(boolean value, String message) {
        if (!value) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
    public static void await(CountDownLatch latch) throws InterruptedException {
        if (!latch.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new AssertionError("latch timeout");
    }
    public static <T> T get(Future<T> f) throws Exception {
        return f.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    }
    public static void join(Thread t) throws InterruptedException {
        t.join(5000);
        if (t.isAlive()) { t.interrupt(); throw new AssertionError("thread did not stop: " + t.getName()); }
    }
    public static void stop(ExecutorService executor) throws InterruptedException {
        for (Runnable queued : executor.shutdownNow())
            if (queued instanceof Future<?> f) f.cancel(false);
        if (!executor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            throw new AssertionError("executor did not terminate");
    }
    public static Thread thread(String name, AtomicReference<Throwable> failure, Runnable body) {
        return Thread.ofPlatform().daemon().name(name).unstarted(() -> {
            try { body.run(); }
            catch (Throwable error) { failure.compareAndSet(null, error); }
        });
    }
    public static void rethrow(AtomicReference<Throwable> failure) {
        if (failure.get() != null) throw new AssertionError("worker failed", failure.get());
    }
}

存取款模拟：队首不足不能越过，存款触发有序完成

题目约定

金额是long最小货币单位，初始余额非负、交易金额为正。明确采用严格FIFO：队首余额不足时，后面金额更小的请求也不能越过。withdraw返回这次新完成的请求列表，不能完成的留下；deposit也返回被存款解锁的新完成列表，调用者按列表输出。队列有容量，满则拒绝且不占用请求ID；重复取款ID显式拒绝，不冒充“返回原结果”的幂等重放。

我会这样保证正确性

一个monitor保护余额、FIFO队列和历史ID。drain只从队首检查与扣减，余额始终非负，每个已接收取款最多被移出并完成一次。deposit先Math.addExact再赋值，溢出不改余额或队列；不能把先检查余额和后扣款拆成两个独立线程安全操作。

复杂度

单次存取可能触发k个排队请求，O(k)，每个请求最多入出一次；队列O(capacity)，历史ID集合O(total requests)没有淘汰。不是因为有界队列就整个进程内存有界。

边界测试

先排20再排5，余额10时两个均等待；补10仅完成队首，补5完成第二个；满队列拒绝、重复ID拒绝、非正金额、Long.MAX_VALUE溢出不变；100存款与100取款并发检查唯一完成、总额与排队归零。

适用边界

这是内存输出模拟，不使用真实银行账户。没有持久化、请求重放结果查询、存款幂等、取消取款或账户间转账。如果面试要求评审一段指定代码，需要先拿到代码，再判断它是否满足这些条件。

面试官继续追问时

若要求取消排队请求，需要明确取消与完成竞争的原子结果；若要求跨进程/崩溃恢复，余额、请求状态、输出事件需事务化，并用稳定请求身份恢复，不能把输出丢失当成再次扣款理由。

FifoBank.java · 完整源码

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public final class FifoBank {
    public record Withdrawal(String id, long amount) {}
    private long balance;
    private final ArrayDeque<Withdrawal> waiting = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Set<String> usedIds = new HashSet<>();
    private final int capacity;
    public FifoBank(long balance, int capacity) {
      if (balance < 0 || capacity < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
      this.balance = balance; this.capacity = capacity;
    }
    // FIFO: a smaller later withdrawal never bypasses an unfunded head.
    public synchronized List<Withdrawal> withdraw(String id, long amount) {
      if (id == null || id.isBlank() || amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
      if (usedIds.contains(id)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate request id");
      if (waiting.size() >= capacity) throw new RejectedExecutionException("queue full");
      usedIds.add(id); waiting.addLast(new Withdrawal(id, amount));
      return drain();
    }
    public synchronized List<Withdrawal> deposit(long amount) {
      if (amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
      balance = Math.addExact(balance, amount); // no mutation if overflow
      return drain();
    }
    private List<Withdrawal> drain() {
      List<Withdrawal> done = new ArrayList<>();
      while (!waiting.isEmpty() && waiting.peekFirst().amount() <= balance) {
        Withdrawal w = waiting.removeFirst(); balance -= w.amount(); done.add(w);
      }
      return List.copyOf(done);
    }
    public synchronized long balance() { return balance; }
    public synchronized int pending() { return waiting.size(); }
  }
